title: Common Gabriel–Popescu module presentation and compact derived source
statement: Let A be an abelian category with objects in universe uA and morphisms in universe vA, Grothendieck relative to w, with a chosen w-Hom derived category and coproducts indexed by Type max(w,vA,vH) in D(A). There is a ring S in Type w, a chosen derived category of ModuleCat.{max w vH} S with Hom universe max(w,vH), and additive exact F : ModuleCat.{max w vH} S → A left adjoint to U, with invertible abelian counit. There is a triangulated category B with objects in Type max(uA,vA,max(w,vH)+1) and morphisms in Type max(w,vH), with additive integer shifts and coproducts indexed by Type max(w,vH), compactly generated in the sense of [def-pc-compactly-generated], and an equivalence e : B ≌ D(ModuleCat.{max w vH} S) whose functor commutes with integer shifts and preserves distinguished triangles. No derived adjunction or derived counit assertion is part of this statement.

source.place: injectives-lemma-gabriel-popescu; Tag 0F5X first paragraph; Tag 05NU for Baer criterion in the size extension

proof.text: Apply the abelian core to obtain S, the derived module category, the adjunction, exactness, and invertible counit. Apply the compact derived source core to the same S and combine the resulting existential witnesses.

lean.statement:
theorem grothendieckDerived_gabriel_popescu_presentation
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vH} (DerivedCategory A)] :
    ∃ (S : Type w) (rS : Ring S),
      letI := rS
      ∃ hD : HasDerivedCategory.{max w vH} (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S),
      letI := hD
      ∃ (F : ModuleCat.{max w vH} S ⥤ A) (U : A ⥤ ModuleCat.{max w vH} S)
        (adj₀ : F ⊣ U) (addF : F.Additive)
        (limF : PreservesFiniteLimits F) (colimF : PreservesFiniteColimits F),
      letI := addF
      letI := limF
      letI := colimF
      IsIso adj₀.counit ∧
      ∃ (B : Type (max uA vA ((max w vH) + 1))) (cB : Category.{max w vH} B),
      letI := cB
      ∃ (zB : HasZeroObject B) (sB : HasShift B ℤ) (pB : Preadditive B),
      letI := zB
      letI := sB
      letI := pB
      ∃ aB : ∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor B n).Additive,
      letI := aB
      ∃ tB : Pretriangulated B,
      letI := tB
      ∃ (iB : IsTriangulated B) (sumsB : HasCoproducts.{max w vH} B),
      letI := iB
      letI := sumsB
      IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{max w vH} B ∧
      ∃ (e : B ≌ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S))
        (se : e.functor.CommShift ℤ),
      letI := se
      e.functor.IsTriangulated
